article.title: Power of Central Government or Board to condone delays in obtaining approval.
article.content: Where, the approval of the Central Government or the Board is required to be obtained before a specified date under this Act, it shall be open to the Central Government or the Board to condone, for sufficient cause, any delay in obtaining such approval.
article.html:
528Power of Central Government or Board to condone delays in obtaining approval.

Section 528 · Chapter XXIII · page 616 of the Act

Where, the approval of the Central Government or the Board is required to be obtained before a specified date under this Act, it shall be open to the Central Government or the Board to condone, for sufficient cause, any delay in obtaining such approval.
